target_moa.text: Atezolizumab is an Fc-engineered, humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody that binds to PD-L1 and blocks its interactions with the PD-1 and B7.1 receptors, relieving PD-L1/PD-1-mediated inhibition of the anti-tumor immune response.

citations.quote: Atezolizumab is an Fc-engineered, humanized, monoclonal antibody that binds to PD-L1 and blocks interactions with the PD-1 and B7.1 receptors. Atezolizumab is a non-glycosylated IgG1 kappa immunoglobulin that has a calculated molecular mass of 145 kDa.
Binding of PD-L1 to the PD-1 and B7.1 receptors found on T cells and antigen presenting cells suppresses cytotoxic T-cell activity, T-cell proliferation and cytokine production.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>=20%): fatigue (52%), decreased appetite, nausea (25%), urinary tract infection (22%), pyrexia (21%), and constipation (21%). Serious risks include severe infections (Grade 3/4 infection in 11.5% of urothelial patients) and immune-related adverse reactions.
